name: Farren's Report
summary: In Southshore, Farren's Report carries Lieutenant Farren Orinelle's findings on the local naga. He hopes the dispatch will win him a return to Stormwind.

sections.title: A Ticket Out of Southshore
sections.body: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle grew tired of Southshore's embattled coast, its local leadership, and its remote frontier. He had adventurers hunt the Daggerspine naga to gather proof of their threat, then gathered the findings into a formal report. Farren plans to send it to Major Samuelson, captain of the guard in Stormwind Keep, rather than to his commanding officer, Marshal Redpath. Samuelson trained Farren, and Farren hopes the report will show his competence and earn him an immediate transfer back to Stormwind City's comforts.

faq.answer: Farren's Report is a military dispatch by Lieutenant Farren Orinelle, summarizing his operations against the Daggerspine naga encroaching on Southshore's beaches.

faq.q: Why does Farren want this delivered to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Farren hopes to leave Southshore and return to Stormwind City. He sends the report to Major Samuelson, his former mentor and captain of the Stormwind guard, hoping for a favorable transfer.

faq.q: Why is Farren keeping the report a secret from Redpath?
faq.answer: Farren wants to avoid scrutiny from Marshal Redpath and local leadership. They might take offense at an officer using a local threat to arrange a personal transfer back to safety in the capital.

faq.q: How does Major Samuelson react upon receiving it?
faq.answer: Major Samuelson praises his former student for taking initiative against the Southshore naga. He promises to consider the report when reviewing guard assignments in the coming month.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Farren's Report reveals the maneuvering within its military, as officers in distant Hillsbrad seek safer duty in Stormwind.
As a human of the Alliance, carrying Farren's Report connects besieged Southshore with the royal court in Stormwind Keep.
